QUOTE: `app/actions/websocket/channel.ts:463` | Nothing extra | If the user is viewing this channel, kick them out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`; then remove the current user from the channel locally. | and `archiveChannel` row: "Set `delete_at` locally so the channel stays visible as archived." / "Remove the current user's membership locally instead."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable the user is removed from the channel (kicked out if it is the current channel), and when viewable the channel stays and is marked archived via `delete_at`.
